title: Signal Decay Monitoring for PEAD Pipeline (H163/H174)
source: MDPI 18/8/412 — News Sentiment and Stock Market Dynamics
summary: Sentiment alpha decays rapidly in recent years. MDPI paper documents monitoring framework: rolling Sharpe tracking per stock cohort, 30-day retraining triggers, audit logs. Should be added to H163/H174 production pipeline.

action.what: Add signal decay monitoring to PEAD paper trading pipeline
how: Track 30-day rolling Sharpe per stock in the 30-stock universe
Alert when any stock's rolling Sharpe drops below 0.5 (individual) or portfolio below 0.8
Schedule quarterly FinBERT model revalidation on fresh 8-K corpus
Log H176 (ModernFinBERT) transition as next upgrade when decay detected
action.effort: LOW — half-day to add monitoring to existing paper trading script
